root_cause: the test closed a live File HANDLE and then reused its stale numeric value; Windows could recycle that value before GetSecurityInfo, producing a different valid object and a truthful code other than ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE
observed_failures: full package suite: observe_security_descriptor_digest returned Win32 Readback code 5 instead of code 6
isolated old test: verify_security_exact returned SecurityMismatch instead of Win32 Readback code 6
first replacement used INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE, which aliases the current-process pseudo-handle and therefore returned SecurityMismatch

independent_probe.mechanism: direct PowerShell P/Invoke to GetSecurityInfo with SE_FILE_OBJECT and a NULL handle

fix: product wrappers now delegate to private raw-handle helpers; the test passes NULL directly and never constructs a Rust File from or after an invalid handle
proof_ceiling: local Windows proof for the current dirty worktree; no hosted CI or clean-clone receipt
